tools.name: search_mcp_servers
tools.description: Search indexed remote MCP servers by intended task, capability, product, category, endpoint metadata, or associated tools.

tools.name: search_mcp_tools
tools.description: Search individual tool capabilities across every indexed MCP server and identify each matching parent server.

tools.name: get_mcp_server
tools.description: Get a complete structured server record, endpoints, tools, evidence-based trust, risks, warnings and install options.

tools.name: get_mcp_tool
tools.description: Get one tool schema, parent server, endpoint, availability, inferred risk and parent installation instructions.

tools.name: get_mcp_endpoint
tools.description: Get stored transport, authentication, protocol, availability, latency, TLS, redirect and schema-change information for an indexed endpoint.

tools.name: get_install_instructions
tools.description: Generate client-specific, copyable installation instructions without embedding credentials.

tools.name: check_mcp_endpoint
tools.description: Return the most recently stored check for an indexed endpoint. This never scans an arbitrary URL.

tools.name: compare_mcp_servers
tools.description: Compare two to four known RMCP servers by capabilities, tools, auth, transport, evidence, risk, latency and installation complexity.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_install_instructions" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Generate client-specific, copyable installation instructions without embedding credentials.
